sources.beginner: Hand rows as taught in beginner/m06/l02-working-the-capstone.md (year 1, year 4, year 5, payback); life total from the Suite Fiscal Regime Designer summary (src/components/fiscaldesigner/ResultsPanel.jsx, all toFixed(1)). Panels are select-only teaching cases.
sources.intermediate: Year-specific rows by hand (pool, R factor, royalty; the Designer prints none of them); NPV from the Designer summary toFixed(1); total tax is printed nowhere in the Designer.
sources.advanced: One Suite Fiscal Regime Designer run (runFiscalComparison, src/pages/apps/FiscalRegimeDesigner.jsx:11): summary table and sweep tooltips, every figure toFixed(1) (ResultsPanel.jsx:53/144/163, priceShareChart.js:108).

fields.evidence: Step two builds year 1 gross revenue by hand: (5200x58 + 65x3.2 + 480x27) x 365 / 1e6 = 114.89032 exactly; full precision from a calculator.
fields.notes: NextGen fiscal panels are select-only over ODIDI/default/test projects and panelCapstoneGuard.test.js bars URUAN, so no panel reaches this case; probe shows no hit.

fields.evidence: 14 percent of year 4 gross (each stream declined three times after booking, as the prompt and m06/l02 step two teach); closed form, full precision. The Designer prints no per-year royalty.
9 + 6.5 USD x year 4 boe (gas at 6000 scf/bbl) / 1e6; closed form. Step three quotes year 4 opex the same way; the Designer prints no opex column.
Built row by row as steps two and three teach (pool cleared under a 100 percent limit); five rows by hand give full precision.
fields.notes: The Designer shows it only as a bar tooltip `$${mm(v)}MM` with mm = toFixed(1) (src/components/fiscaldesigner/ResultsPanel.jsx:53,186); a learner who reads the app instead of building the row gets 1 decimal against tol 0.001.

fields.evidence: Step four reads the cumulative at the first year above zero; a handful of hand-built rows reach the payback year at full precision.
fields.notes: Designer payout chart tooltip prints toFixed(1) (src/components/fiscaldesigner/ResultsPanel.jsx:215). Same risk as year 5 NCF if read from the app.

fields.recommendation: Tolerance to 0.05 (half a unit of the 1 decimal the Fiscal Regime Designer prints) is the minimal honest fix. Alternative: give the Designer a full-precision ledger/summary export (the lessons quote engine columns to 4 decimals that the Designer never prints) and keep 0.001.
fields.evidence: Life total over 25 rows is read from the engine ("proves two rows and trusts the other twenty three", src/content/courses/fiscal/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md:37); the Designer summary prints `{s.govTake.toFixed(1)}` against tol 0.001.
65 percent of year 1 revenue after royalty (6 percent tier at 58 USD/bbl), capped by the pool; one closed-form row. The Designer prints no cost recovery column.
fields.notes: NextGen fiscal panels are select-only over ODIDI/default/test projects and panelCapstoneGuard.test.js bars URUAN, so no panel reaches this case; probe shows no hit.

fields.evidence: Pool = brought forward + capex + opex minus recovered, carried three rows (intermediate m02 and m06/l02 step four); hand rows give full precision. Not printed by the Designer.

Ratio of cumulative revenue to cumulative cost through year 5, both regime-independent columns (m03/l01); five rows by hand. Lessons and panels print R to 6 decimals (RegimeExplorer.jsx:24 toFixed(6)), tol 1e-6 exceeds half a unit there.
fields.notes: No reporting precision in the prompt ("as a ratio"). A learner who rounds to 4 decimals (1.1123) misses tol 1e-6 by 3.8e-5; the course convention of 6 decimals passes. Borderline; left as none.

fields.evidence: 9.5 percent of year 8 gross at the stepped 72 USD/bbl deck: closed form, full precision; tol 0.0003 is wider than half a unit at the course's 4 decimals.

fields.recommendation: The Designer summary has NPV, IRR, payback, government cash flow and the two shares but no tax, and no chart separates tax from royalty and profit share. Either print total tax (and ideally the ledger) in the Designer, or accept that the learner builds the full 25-row PSC ledger by hand (a spreadsheet can, but the lessons direct life totals to the engine).
